+import os
+from typing import Iterable, Iterator, Optional
+
+from openai import OpenAI
+
+
+def stream_completion(
+    prompt: str,
+    model: str = "gpt-5.4-mini",
+    system: Optional[str] = None,
+) -> Iterator[str]:
+    client = OpenAI(api_key=os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"))
+    messages = []
+    if system:
+        messages.append({"role": "system", "content": system})
+    messages.append({"role": "user", "content": prompt})
+
+    stream = client.chat.completions.create(model=model, messages=messages, stream=True)
+    for chunk in stream:
+        for choice in getattr(chunk, "choices", []):
+            delta = getattr(choice, "delta", None)
+            content = getattr(delta, "content", None) if delta is not None else None
+            if content:
+                yield content
*** End Patch

import os
from typing import Optional

from openai import OpenAI


def summarize_text(text: str, max_tokens: int = 256, model: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
    client = OpenAI(api_key=os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"))
    response = client.responses.create(
        model=model or "gpt-4o-mini",
        input=[
            {
                "role": "system",
                "content": "Summarize the provided text concisely and accurately.",
            },
            {"role": "user", "content": text},
        ],
        max_output_tokens=max_tokens,
    )
    return response.output_text

+import json
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_API_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions"
+OPENAI_MODEL = os.getenv("OPENAI_MODEL", "gpt-5.4-mini")
+
+
+def extract_json(text: str, schema_hint: str, api_key: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    token = api_key or os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not token:
+        raise ValueError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+
+    messages = [
+        {
+            "role": "system",
+            "content": "Extract structured JSON from the provided text. Return only valid JSON.",
+        },
+        {
+            "role": "user",
+            "content": f"Schema hint: {schema_hint}\n\nText:\n{text}",
+        },
+    ]
+
+    response = requests.post(
+        OPENAI_API_URL,
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {token}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        json={
+            "model": OPENAI_MODEL,
+            "messages": messages,
+            "temperature": 0,
+            "response_format": {"type": "json_object"},
+        },
+        timeout=60,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    payload = response.json()
+    content = payload["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]
+    return json.loads(content)
*** End Patch

+import os
+from typing import Optional
+
+from openai import OpenAI
+
+
+def summarize_text(text: str, max_tokens: int = 256, model: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
+    client = OpenAI(api_key=os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"))
+    response = client.responses.create(
+        model=model or "gpt-4o-mini",
+        input=[
+            {
+                "role": "system",
+                "content": "Summarize the provided text concisely and accurately.",
+            },
+            {"role": "user", "content": text},
+        ],
+        max_output_tokens=max_tokens,
+    )
+    return response.output_text
